'''July 2001 Mount Prospect tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Games Plus, Mt. Prospect, Illinois on 14 July 2001. [[Kevin James]] won it. It is known from Kevin James's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2654">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-17-mt-prospect-il-7-14-01d2654/ mt-prospect-il-7-14-01], DeckTech (Kevin "Obi-Kev" James, 17 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-17-mt-prospect-il-7-14-01d2654/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 14 July 2001
* '''Site:''' Games Plus, Mt. Prospect, Illinois
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[Kevin James]]
